subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Quaint
solution: The correct answer is **option 2 i.e. Queer** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Quaint **means attractive or unusual because it seems to belong to the past.(आकर्षक या अनूठा (अतीत की वस्‍तु होने के कारण), अनोखा) • **For Example:** • *What** **a** **quaint** **idea**!*** • **Queer **means strange or unusual. (विचित्र, अजीब या असामान्‍य) • **​For Example:** • *His face was a queer pink colour.* • *​*Hence, **Quaint **and **Queer **are synonymous to each other. • Thus the correct answer is **option 2.​** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • **Quite **means not very; to a certain degree; rather.( अधिक नहीं; किसी हदतक; अपेक्षाकृत) • ​**Quack** means the sound that a duck makes.( बत्तख़ की काँ-काँ) • **Quiet **means with very little or no noise.(शांत, ख़ामोश) 3e:Taa6, The correct answer is **option 1 i.e. subtle.**
